_comment: Canonical Task document shape. The g8e-compatible ensemble is the authority - it creates and owns this document. Tasks are governed collection entries submitted via GovernanceEnvelope. A field mismatch breaks task creation, investigation linkage, and governed mutation flows.

task._description: A unit of work tracked within an investigation. Tasks are created by the agent to decompose complex investigations into discrete steps. Governed collection - mutations must go through POST /api/v1/governance/envelopes.

id.description: Unique task identifier (UUID v4). Generated server-side by the agent.

description.description: Task description with details and context.

investigation_id.description: Investigation ID this task belongs to.

case_id.description: Case ID this task is associated with. Inherited from the parent investigation.

user_id.description: User who initiated the task. Injected server-side.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task ID for hierarchical task decomposition.

status.description: Task lifecycle status. See status.json task.status.

priority.description: Priority level (integer enum). Maps to low=1, medium=2, high=3, critical=4.

assignee.description: Component or persona assigned to this task (e.g. 'ai.primary', 'operator').

result.description: Task result or output. Set when the task reaches a terminal status.

error.description: Error message if the task failed.

started_at.description: When the task transitioned to in_progress.

completed_at.description: When the task reached a terminal status.
